//==
// # Overlap, intersection, and culling
//
// How one region relates to another, filtered requests for everything inside an
// axis-aligned region, the discrete intersection points of two primitives, and
// the outcome of culling an indexed set against a convex volume. FilterMask is a
// category bitmask combined with a candidate's category bits by bitwise AND
// (non-zero passes), and -1 (all bits set) accepts everything.

// How one region A relates to another region B: no shared points, an overlap
// without full containment, A fully containing B, or A lying fully inside B.
type Containment = Disjoint | Intersects | Contains | Within;
